patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Grafana Cloud and Sentry share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Grafana Cloud and Sentry share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Grafana Cloud only if your buying job matches “Managed Grafana observability — Free 10k series / 50 GB logs; Pro from $19/mo platform fee” rather than Sentry's shape. Choose Sentry only if your buying job matches “Application error monitoring, tracing, and replays — Developer Free; Team $26/mo annual wi” rather than Grafana Cloud's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Grafana Cloud is shaped for Managed Grafana observability — Free 10k series / 50 GB logs; Pro from whereas Sentry is shaped for Application error monitoring, tracing, and replays — Developer Free; T. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Grafana Cloud and Sentry share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Grafana Cloud is Managed Grafana observability — Free 10k series / 50 GB logs; Pro from $19/mo platform fee + usage ($6.50/1k series, $8/user).; Sentry is Application error monitoring, tracing, and replays — Developer Free; Team $26/mo annual with default prepaid; Business $80/mo. Not a Datadog.
- Company-size focus: Grafana Cloud (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Sentry (solo, micro, small-business).
- Researched limits: Grafana Cloud — Pro bills many usage dimensions — the $19 fee is not the bill; Sentry — Not a Datadog-style infrastructure monitoring suite — errors/traces/replays are the job.

Limitations — Grafana Cloud: Pro bills many usage dimensions — the $19 fee is not the bill; Free retention is 14 days — production teams usually need Pro; Sentry: Not a Datadog-style infrastructure monitoring suite — errors/traces/replays are the job; Prepaid event volume on Team/Business is the TCO lever beyond $26/$80 stickers.

Poor-fit cases: Grafana Cloud is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Pro bills many usage dimensions — the $19 fee is not the bill · Sentry is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a Datadog-style infrastructure monitoring suite — errors/traces/replays are the job · Avoid Grafana Cloud if you actually need Sentry's motion (Application error monitoring, tracing, and replays — Developer Free; Team $26/mo)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
